steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up the directory structure and create core build configuration files tailored for high-performance Java interpretation on Android.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Define permissions, register activities, set the application theme to Dark Material, and define application entry points.

steps.title: Create Main UI Layout
steps.description: Construct the multi-panel dark theme layout containing a file manager, syntax-highlighted editor with line numbers, controls (Compile, Run, Stop), and a scrollable output console.

steps.title: Develop Java Lexer and Tokenizer
steps.description: Implement the syntax scanner inside the execution engine that tokenizes raw Java code strings into meaningful syntactical components for parsing.

steps.title: Implement AST Expression Parser
steps.description: Build the mathematical and logical expression parser, supporting binary operations, local variables, dynamic strings, and operator precedence.

steps.title: Implement Runtime Statement Executor
steps.description: Implement AST execution blocks supporting basic statements like variable assignment, conditional If/Else branching, nested structures, and loops.

steps.title: Design Custom Syntax Highlighting Editor
steps.description: Write code to apply custom visual text styling to keywords, literals, type systems, comments, and numbers on-the-fly without UI stutter.

steps.title: Build Editor Line Number Coordinator
steps.description: Synchronize the text views and lines of the code editor with a specialized line numbering widget to align matching indices accurately.

steps.title: Create Local File Manager and Project Store
steps.description: Program functions to manage user workspace files locally, including initial demo template generation, reading, writing, renaming, and file listing.

steps.title: Build Background Executor with Threads
steps.description: Architect asynchronous thread control, allowing non-blocking source parsing, intermediate compilation output, direct program state interruption, and console logging safely.

steps.title: Building Java Runner
steps.description: Compile, verify code compliance, link resources, package configurations, and output the functional Android debugging APK application.
